Class PasskeyService

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.security.passkey.PasskeyService
@Service public class PasskeyService extends Object
Registration, management and sign-in of passkeys on top of PasskeyRelyingParty. The challenge of every ceremony is kept in PasskeyChallengeStore; the answer is checked against the stored entry only.

A registration needs the proof of a new sign-in method (password, and a code while an authenticator app is enabled). A sign-in needs nothing but the passkey, which must have been created with user verification and must verify the user again; it then completes like a password sign-in, without the second factor, which a passkey replaces.

      public CredentialChangeService.PasskeyChange register(Integer idUser, tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode body)
      Verifies and stores a new passkey. The challenge must be a registration challenge of this user, built for the current public address, and no credential change may have happened since the proof.
      Parameters:

      body - { challengeId, label, credential }

    • signIn

      public void signIn(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse response) throws IOException
      Verifies an assertion and completes the sign-in, writing token and configuration into the response. An unknown or expired challenge is refused without counting; an assertion that fails verification counts toward the block of the client address. The owner of the credential is read before the assertion is verified, and the sign-in completes with exactly that snapshot.
      Throws:
      IOException
